description: Rules for controlling physical and logical access to information are not established based on business requirements.
applicability: Applies when an organization has not defined access control policies based on business and security requirements, or lacks rules governing who can access what information, systems, and facilities under what circumstances.

metadata.detection_notes: Review access control policy documentation, assess whether policies define access rights based on roles and business needs, verify policies cover both physical and logical access, check for least privilege principles, evaluate policy approval and communication.
